sections.name: Ancient Tenacity
sections.description_summary: Passive: when HP first drops below 30%, Ulmus retreats to the backline and roots, recovering HP; while rooted he is unaffected, cannot move, and normal attacks become ranged with splash damage. Active cast knocks the target and adjacent enemies airborne and deals damage plus max-HP-based damage.

sections.name: Verdant Barrier
sections.description_summary: Creates a self-shield; when it breaks, damages surrounding enemies. If Ulmus is rooted, grants the shield to the frontmost ally instead.

sections.name: Way of the Forest
sections.description_summary: Provides passive HP recovery; while rooted, converts the recovery into Energy.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases max HP.

sections.name: Prowling Roots
sections.description_summary: When an enemy is knocked down, knocked airborne or displaced, Ulmus binds them to the ground, extends knockdown and deals damage; has a per-target cooldown.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Shield break or expiration knocks adjacent enemies back.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Wrath of the Wilds
sections.description_summary: Opening passive loses 70% HP and gains a Vine Ward shield that regenerates while active; the shield also makes Tilaya unaffected. Active cast swings her greatsword repeatedly in a 2-tile arc, reducing damage taken while casting; taking hits can add swings.

sections.name: Mighty Slash
sections.description_summary: Charges and strikes the target; restores Vine Ward shield based on damage dealt while the shield is active.

sections.name: Wildwood Resonance
sections.description_summary: Increases attack damage based on current shield value; duration is extended by nearby allies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Vitality.

sections.name: Verdant Growth
sections.description_summary: The first Vine Ward break instantly restores the shield; later breaks restore a larger shield after a cooldown. LV 3 grants max HP and Phys/Magic DEF to allies within 2 tiles while Vine Ward remains active.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Vine Ward shield recovery increases while Tilaya casts Ultimate.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases shield value and grants Phys/Magic DEF when shielding; higher ranks also heal based on shield value.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Moonveil Manifest
sections.description_summary: Creates a 12 s ritual zone, reducing enemy Crit DMG DEF. After enemies inside accumulate enough damage, triggers a shadow eruption based on Team ATK and heals allies based on total eruption damage.

sections.name: Darkmoon Pact
sections.description_summary: Selects the ally one tile behind Thador as lieutenant during preparation; lieutenant gains Crit while Thador lives. Active cast shields both.

sections.name: Crescent Cleave
sections.description_summary: Damages enemies in a crescent arc and knocks them down.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction.

sections.name: Umbral Descent
sections.description_summary: When the lieutenant first casts Ultimate, Darkmoon damages all enemies repeatedly and reduces Phys/Magic DEF, then deals a final burst. LV 3 grants the lieutenant 350 Energy at battle start.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Thador restores a percentage of max HP per second while the lieutenant is alive.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken per adjacent enemy. Higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

page_tags_status: The capture excerpt ends during Hero Focus; remaining Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Full Energy
sections.description_summary: Grants Koko and all allies 45% damage reduction for 12 s and records damage reduced; when the effect ends, recorded damage is dealt as true damage to all allies. Also grants Life Drain and ATK; cannot be dispelled.

sections.name: Fulfilling Feast
sections.description_summary: Heals the weakest ally and grants ATK for 5 s. Also feeds Patto to heal it and increase Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Patto, smash!
sections.description_summary: Spear throw damages the target and increases damage they take; if an enemy is adjacent, Patto smashes the ground, damaging and stunning adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Turbulent Resurgence
sections.description_summary: When Stormbound Chain breaks, heals all allies and casts Stormbound Chain again, up to three casts per battle. LV 3 stuns the last two linked enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: While Zephyr's Embrace is active, the protected target becomes unaffected. LV 2 allows more Stormbound Chain casts, adds max-HP reduction based on transferred damage, and transfers Zephyr's Embrace to the highest-damage ally when the chain breaks.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides an opening buff for the ally placed one tile in front: increases melee damage and reduces ranged damage taken; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt begins at Exclusive Equipment; recapture base abilities, Hero Focus and other sections.

sections.name: Fiery Dance
sections.description_summary: Damages surrounding enemies within 2 tiles; Satrana is invincible during the effect. LV 2 charms enemies with the final strike, limiting them to normal attacks.

sections.name: Vixen Rush
sections.description_summary: Scratches enemies in a 1-tile arc twice, dealing ATK damage plus target max-HP-based extra damage; damage grants Life Drain.

sections.name: Ignite Passions
sections.description_summary: Grants Sparks to allies within 2 tiles at battle start. When Satrana or a Spark ally hits an enemy three times, ignites them for max-HP-based damage over time and reduces Vitality until battle ends.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction.

sections.name: Radiant Vigor
sections.description_summary: Ignited enemy heroes reduce magic damage taken by Satrana; she shares the effect with a nearby ally when another enemy is ignited. Higher ranks grant Energy per ignited enemy and improve reduction.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt does not show Enhance Force, Season Charm or Rivalry Mode; recapture the remainder.

sections.name: Grand Entrance
sections.description_summary: At battle start grants the buffs of Vibrant Dance and Healing Gemstones to the ally placed one tile in front. Higher levels increase that ally's Vitality.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When an ally's HP first drops below 50% while Healing Gemstones is active, Fay heals them; once per skill use.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening melee-damage buff and ranged damage reduction for the ally placed one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt begins at Exclusive Equipment; recapture base abilities and Hero Focus.

sections.name: Drowning Doom
sections.description_summary: Passive: enemies kept under control effects for 6 s take damage and become Drowning; threshold is 4 s for enemies dealing magic damage. Nerion deals more damage to Drowning enemies. Active cast empowers Nerion for 12 s with ATK/ATK SPD and Deluge bouncing damage between Drowning enemies.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Abyssal Embrace
sections.description_summary: At battle start applies Drowning to the rearmost enemy, reducing their ATK/Haste and dealing periodic damage while they are controlled.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: When all non-summoned enemies (or four total) are Drowning, Nerion gains 1000 Energy and becomes permanently empowered; gains Penetration above an Energy threshold.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Under a stationary-tile condition, after 3 s increases damage and Haste; higher ranks add shield/steadfast.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Euphoric Rush
sections.description_summary: Strikes enemies in a marked 2-tile area six times, then detonates for AOE damage and charms enemies for 3 s.

sections.name: Blissful Whip
sections.description_summary: Hits all units (allies and enemies) in a frontal arc five times. Allies hit gain Haste for 8 s and suffer reduced HP loss from this skill.

sections.name: Alluring Mirage
sections.description_summary: Summons an illusion near the enemy lineup and bewitches all enemies, making them rush toward it. At battle start, summons an illusion on the symmetrical tile.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Life Drain; ATK increases based on cumulative healing received.

sections.name: Total Devotion
sections.description_summary: Summons three voidlings. When a hit would reduce Mehira below 20% HP, sacrifices one voidling to block damage, becomes untargetable and heals. Excess healing can create additional voidlings.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Enemies charmed by Euphoric Rush or bewitched by Alluring Mirage take 15% more damage; does not stack.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.
